note: Distilled from Exhibit's shipped guard suite and playbooks. When this manifest and Exhibit disagree, Exhibit's shipped behavior wins; re-cut this manifest when Exhibit improves (versioned releases alongside the kit).

checks.description: Every indexable route ships static prerendered HTML with unique <title>, meta description, canonical, OG/Twitter tags, and JSON-LD in the initial response (no JS required).
Routes ⇄ SEO-map keys match exactly; a page missing its SEO entry (or vice versa) fails the build.
Each indexable page is self-canonical on the ONE canonical origin.
Unknown paths return a noindex 404 stub with a real 404 status — never homepage HTML (soft-404).
robots.txt present, allows crawling, references sitemap.xml.
sitemap.xml generated from the SEO map at build time (never hand-edited); lastmod from a content-hash→date map, never the build date.
Every page has a .md twin generated from rendered <main>; llms.txt + llms-full.txt regenerate deterministically each build.
All JSON-LD parses, has @context/@type, no dangling @id refs; recommended-properties pinned to zero warnings.

Property entity dual-typed [ApartmentComplex, LocalBusiness]; reviews/aggregateRating on LocalBusiness with dates; Organization referenced by @id; FloorPlan nodes per plan; Apartment+Offer via itemOffered @id.
Never the same aggregateRating twice (prerendered + client-injected) — strip one before hydration.
Every content image has meaningful alt text.
Per-image byte budget (~195KB) met with encoder size-targeting at full pixel width; largest srcset rung ≥ ~1920px.
OG share cards (1200×630) script-generated from a page→photo/tagline map with a byte-compare freshness test.
axe-core pass on every prerendered page; focus traps skip hidden controls; visible breadcrumbs mirror BreadcrumbList exactly.
Hash-based CSP served (Report-Only first, enforced via env flag); GTM-injected inline scripts have explicit hashes; Ads/Maps/embed hosts present.
GTM/gtag load deferred to first real gesture (never scroll) or post-load; page self-loads gtag.js with send_page_view:false; every custom event carries send_to.
Custom events (generate_lead etc.) verified reaching /g/collect; page_views stream-owned (no manual doubles).
Apex→www, http→https, and every legacy URL 301 in exactly one hop to the exact target; parity map fully classified (no NEEDS_REVIEW rows).
Canonicals consistent with the platform's directory-index 301; zero-redirect (ads) URLs use the trailing-slash form.
Availability from unit_vacancy via server proxy w/ cache; rented rows dropped; posted-to-website only; snapshot baked with stamp-refresh rule; fail closed to last good snapshot.
Guest cards snake_case; unit→listable_uid resolved server-side; fire-and-forget after lead persisted; name/email normalization; dedupe & spam-throttle awareness.
Showing scheduler accepts both slot formats, alarms on all-dropped; every 5xx/409 returns hosted-scheduler fallback; hidden Tour unit via reserved token; identity-verification gate handled.
Honeypot (nonsense name, no label) + elapsedMs checked server-side BEFORE any side effect; fake-201 for bots; fallback never re-enters rejected bots.
Visit-scoped source capture (?source → UTM → click-IDs), label exactly 'Website (Token)', server-side sanitizeLeadSource as trust boundary, injected into every lead/deep link.
Lighthouse vs dist through the production server; route-chunk preload before first render (CLS); inert SSR placeholders for post-hydration controls; one LCP preload per page matching the body.
Production served by the kit's Express server (autoscale): precompressed assets, security headers, real 301s/404s, trust proxy = private CIDRs, /healthz.
Build-id stamp + workspace watcher detects each publish and runs live checks (heads, redirects, schema, GTM); alarms route to the alert inbox only.
Post-publish IndexNow submission of new/changed URLs by diffing live sitemap lastmods against gitignored state.
Technical alerts → alert inbox; leads → leasing inbox; per-reason daily throttle; sliding-window alarms use exact per-event rows; claim-before-send releases on ALL failure paths.
Hub pages + related-guide links + breadcrumb/nav conventions live; link-name guard green (no bare 'click here'/duplicate ambiguous names).
FaqSection/QuickAnswer components wired with FAQPage JSON-LD; answer-first blocks (<100 words) on Q&A pages.
Knowledge Center machinery live: data-driven slugs, rewrite pairs, llms.txt regeneration, review-date cadence — content slots may be empty but the system must run.
Blog engine live: draft gating, publish-readiness simulation (incl. inbound related links), citation CreativeWork JSON-LD, 'next guide up' queue check.
Numeric facts (sqft/prices/counts) guarded against the single source-of-truth data file; uncertain facts flagged in the uncertainty register, never invented.
